title: Peach–Grand Marnier Flan Pâtissier
summary: Vanilla-bean flan pâtissier layered with peaches caramelized in butter, sugar, orange zest and Grand Marnier.
ingredients: Pâte sucrée shell, frozen before filling
6 small egg yolks (or 4 large yolks + 1 extra yolk)
Butter, sugar, orange zest and Grand Marnier for caramelizing
method: Caramelize the peaches in butter, sugar, orange zest and Grand Marnier; cool completely.
Heat milk with vanilla. Whisk yolks with sugar, cornstarch and flour.
Temper the yolk mixture, return to the heat and cook until very thick.
Layer custard and peaches in the frozen pâte sucrée shell; finish with peaches on top.
Bake until deeply set and caramelized at the edges. Chill thoroughly before slicing.
notes: Two layers of peaches gave the finished flan a more dramatic fruit profile. The extra small yolk strengthened the custard.

title: Grand Marnier Madeleines
summary: Browned-butter madeleines built around Grand Marnier, orange, honey and overnight maturation.
method: Brown the butter and cool until warm, not hot.
Whisk eggs and sugar until smooth; fold in flour and salt.
Add browned butter, Grand Marnier, honey and orange zest.
Bake cold batter in a well-prepared madeleine pan until domed and golden.
notes: An overnight rest improves hydration, aroma integration and the characteristic hump.

title: Canelés de Bordeaux
summary: Vanilla canelés developed through flour, mold, maturation and high-heat caramelization experiments.
method: Infuse milk with vanilla and butter; cool slightly.
Combine sugar and flour, then incorporate eggs and yolks without excessive aeration.
Gradually add warm milk; add spirit if using.
Bake in prepared molds with an initial high-heat phase, then reduce heat until mahogany-dark and crisp.
notes: The archive tracks mold material, beeswax/butter treatment and the high-heat caramelization window.

title: Tarte Bourdaloue — Ayala Variation
summary: Pear-and-almond tart with vanilla, Seville orange, Grand Marnier and dark-rum poached pears.
method: Prepare and chill the pâte sucrée shell.
Poach pears with vanilla, citrus and spirits; cool and drain.
Fill shell with almond cream and arrange pears.
Bake until the almond cream is deeply golden and the pears are glazed.
notes: Ayala variation: layered citrus and spirit aromatics added to the classic pear-and-frangipane structure.
